text:
(8) A fine imposed under subsection (7) above shall be deemed, for the purposes
of any enactment, to be a sum adjudged to be paid by a conviction.

(9) If in pursuance of this section a person has his evidence taken as a deposition,
the clerk of the justice concerned shall as soon as is reasonably practicable
send a copy of the deposition to the prosecutor.

(10) If in pursuance of this section a person produces an exhibit which is a
document, the clerk of the justice concerned shall as soon as is reasonably
practicable send a copy of the document to the prosecutor.

(11) If in pursuance of this section a person produces an exhibit which is not a
document, the clerk of the justice concerned shall as soon as is reasonably
practicable inform the prosecutor of the fact and of the nature of the exhibit.”]
